name: The Forresta Kitchen & Bar
why_it_matters: Inside Devraj Niwas, Bani Park — white-washed indoor flowing into a green outdoor garden, lit by string lights at night. One of the post-2015 standalones the Bani Park hotel cluster sends guests to for a non-heritage dinner.
insider_tip: Outdoor garden seats are October-March only. Live music starts after 8pm Friday and Saturday — sit indoors if you want to talk.
signature_address: Devraj Niwas, MI Road, near Khasa Kothi flyover, Bani Park, Jaipur 302016

name: Anokhi Cafe
why_it_matters: On the second floor of KK Square above the Anokhi block-print store. Salads and microgreens come from the Anokhi farm outside Jaipur, picked the same morning. Pure-veg by design, run by the textile family.
insider_tip: Tables turn slow and the cafe doesn't take bookings — go before 12:30pm or after 3pm to avoid the lunch crush. The seasonal soup-and-quiche set is the best-value plate.
signature_address: 2nd Floor, KK Square, C-11 Prithviraj Road, C-Scheme, Jaipur 302001
